title: jmap-client: response body size caps (security)
description: Standalone tracking for the HIGH security finding from Phase 1 GAP analysis: jmap-client has no response body size limits on fetch_session, call, or download_blob. A malicious or misconfigured server can send an unbounded response, causing OOM. This is tracked separately from JMAP-aax for auditability — the fix is implemented in JMAP-aax but this bead records the security decision and links to it.
design: Implementation is in JMAP-aax. Limits: fetch_session <= 1 MiB, call <= 8 MiB, download_blob <= 64 MiB. Mechanism: use reqwest response.bytes_stream() with a manual byte count, or wrap the body with tokio::io::AsyncReadExt::take(). Add ClientError::ResponseTooLarge(u64 /* actual_size */, u64 /* limit */) so callers can distinguish size rejections from other errors. These limits should be configurable via a field on JmapClient or via TransportConfig.
